lines.text: Where is thy brother Bassianus?
lines.plainText: Where is thy brother Bassianus

lines.text: Poor Bassianus here lies murdered.

lines.text: The complot of this timeless tragedy;

lines.text: Sweet huntsman, Bassianus 'tis we mean,
lines.plainText: Sweet huntsman Bassianus 'tis we mean

lines.text: Do thou so much as dig the grave for him;
lines.plainText: Do thou so much as dig the grave for him

lines.text: Which overshades the mouth of that same pit
